no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not taken to an FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected and there were no controversial issues that would benefit from discussion by an advisory committee.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for BLA761172 (Ebanga/ansuvimab-zykl). The Integrated Review states the application was not taken to an advisory committee because it raised no unexpected safety/efficacy issues and had no controversial issues warranting discussion; it separately notes the BLA was not presented at the Antimicrobial Drugs Advisory Committee given its Breakthrough Therapy designation and non-controversial benefit-risk assessment. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm concern-to-change linkages.
